title: A sustained-release strategy of fluorinated solvents enables highly safe lithium metal batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE03640B, Paper
Zhimeng Sheng, Xiaoyu Guo, Rong Gu, Shengtao Xu, Yizheng Ma, Jiayao Shan, Zhangyue Wei, Hongyu Shi, Shuaiqi Gong, Jinting Xu, Yan Zhang, Sheng Zhu, Guodong Qi, Yulin Min
This study proposes a fluorinated solvent sustained-release strategy, which enables the gradual release of fluorinated solvents during thermal runaway.
